title: gelasia lasiocarpa
intro: Gelasia lasiocarpa, commonly known as the "Bearberry" or "Kinnikinnick", is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support urinary tract health and act as a natural diuretic, helping to alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Gelasia lasiocarpa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including arbutin, which has been shown to have antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, and ursolic acid, which has antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant also include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
